title: Biblical Studies
description: Introduction to Biblical concepts and teachings relevant to nursing and healthcare.

title: Medical Nursing I
description: Covers fundamental principles and practices in medical nursing, focusing on patient care.

title: Surgical Nursing I
description: Introduces students to surgical procedures, perioperative care, and related nursing skills.

title: Community Health Nursing II
description: Focuses on public health strategies, community-based care, and health promotion.

title: Pharmacology & Traditional Medicine
description: Explores drug therapy, pharmacokinetics, and traditional medicine integration in nursing.

title: Microbiology & Infection Prevention II
description: Covers microbes, infection control, and hygiene practices in clinical settings.

title: First Aid, Disaster, and Emergency Nursing
description: Study of first aid principles, disaster preparedness, and emergency nursing care essential for handling critical situations in healthcare settings.

title: Anatomy 1
description: Study of the structure and organization of the human body, including the skeletal, muscular, and nervous systems, providing a foundational understanding of human anatomy.
